prior_importants.description: The new guard in `resumeSession` only works if a dead turn writes nothing to the events file. ADR 0103 records that Claude Code's `idle_prompt` Notification also fires when a turn ends without a Stop. If it fires after an API-error death too, the file's mtime moves past the hold and the watchdog resumes the hold's dead turn anyway.

process_issues.description: Round 5 budget: conventions, docs and simplicity were not spawned, though their gates held (a new file, JSDoc and ADR prose). Context and maintainability were not spawned either. Spec did not run: the PR has no closing keyword and no linked issue. Workflow-safety did not run: no workflow file changed.

No reviewer returned a finding, so I spawned no review-consolidator and no validator. Security ran as a single instance: the diff is about 957 changed lines, but only about 300 are source, and the trust surface is one file (cache-hold.service.ts).
